issues.description: `PagingConstsTrait` hard-codes the global x86 page size, level count, and entry ratio as requirements for every paging configuration.
issues.rationale: The generic trait contract requires every implementation to equal architecture-level PAGE_SIZE, NR_LEVELS, and NR_ENTRIES. This rules out otherwise valid paging configurations instead of proving their properties generically. The reviewer questions placing the property in PagingConstsTrait and points out that the x86-specific subpage/entry relation already has its own lemma. The PR was closed as superseded by #532, whose review independently identifies the same hard-coded-trait root cause; it remains present in this fixed head.
